howto.name: Upload a video
howto.text: MP4, WebM, MOV, AVI, MKV — up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose target format
howto.text: MP4 (universal), WebM (open, smaller), MOV (Apple), AVI (legacy), MKV (open container).

howto.name: Download the converted video
howto.text: FFmpeg transcodes via the appropriate codec (H.264 for MP4, VP9/Opus for WebM, etc.).

faq.a: MP4: most compatible. WebM: smaller, used for web embedding. MOV: works in Apple ecosystem and Final Cut. MKV: open-source flexible container.
FFmpeg uses sensible default bitrates that preserve visual quality. For lossless conversion (rare), use the MKV output.
Roughly real-time on the server (a 2-minute video = ~2 minutes to convert).
